Alpaca payloads copied/adapted from the examples on docs.alpaca.markets (streaming, stock bars, snapshots, clock, assets).
They are documentation examples, not recordings of live responses; field shapes may differ slightly in production.
No keys or account data: safe to commit. `stream-mixed.json` adds an unhandled `q` and one deliberately invalid trade.
`rest-news.json` follows the shape of a live `GET /v1beta1/news` response (verified 2026-10-14) with made-up articles.
